name: Samyak International Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Samyak International Ltd trades petrochemical products and other commodities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL is engaged in the trading of Petro products, aluminium caps, toll collection receipts, trading of various commodities. It mainly imports and trades a wide range of Petroleum & Bitumen-Based Products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.35 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 52.0 to 36.5 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 55.8 days to 28.5 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 11.5% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.59% over last 3 years.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
